title: Bug Hunt 2: The Off-By-One
prompt: A report should print the first five multiples of 3 (3, 6, 9, 12, 15). It prints the wrong range — diagnose and fix. Keep the loop a range loop.

tests.name: first five multiples
tests.hint: range(1, 5) gives 1..4 — five numbers means range(1, 6); starting at 0 or 1 both change the values. Check the lesson examples.
